Tail Counter Capture.name: Tail Counter Capture
Tail Counter Capture.description: The user combines a hand parry, a tail hook and a hip turn against one visible attacker within two meters, redirecting the attack into a controlled ground hold without a crushing strike. The tail holds the opponent until they overpower it or the user releases them. The sequence requires firm footing and a readable close attack; afterward the tail trembles and cannot strike until the end of the user's next turn. Strain: severe.
